findings.current: The ground trembled faintly, accompanied by the distant rumble of an explosion that reached us from far away.
findings.defect: The draft identifies the noise as an explosion and adds a first-person reference, although the source only describes a distant roar whose martial origin is established afterward.
findings.rationale: 굉음 denotes a tremendous roar or booming noise here, not an identified explosion, and the Korean contains no equivalent of “us.”
findings.replacement: The ground trembled faintly as a distant roar rolled in from far away.
findings.source: 저 멀리, 아스라이 들려오는 굉음과 함께 지면이 미세하게 떨렸다.

findings.current: Enough time had passed since the Great Faction War for the mountains and rivers to change five times.
findings.defect: The literal rendering leaves the chronological quantity opaque in unnatural English.
findings.rationale: The traditional expression treats one change of the mountains and rivers as roughly ten years, so five changes conveys approximately fifty years.
findings.replacement: Half a century had passed since the Great Faction War.
findings.source: 정마대전으로부터 강산이 다섯 번 바뀔 만큼의 세월이 흘렀다.

findings.current: A waterspout of dust rose around us, blocking everyone else’s view.
findings.defect: A waterspout is specifically a vortex over water and is incompatible with the dust-filled arena described here.
findings.rationale: 용오름 describes the rising vortex itself; the following sentence separately establishes that dust is swirling through it.
findings.replacement: A whirlwind rose around us, blocking everyone else’s view.
findings.source: 우리를 중심으로 솟아오른 용오름이 다른 이들의 시야를 가렸다.

findings.current: “You hit my back before I even got to use it!”
findings.defect: The draft invents the explicit action “You hit my back” and loses Taekyung’s euphemistic joke about not yet having had occasion to use his hips.
findings.rationale: The Korean is a deliberately elliptical complaint centered on his unused 허리, carrying a suggestive comic undertone without explicitly describing the preceding blow.
findings.replacement: “I haven’t even gotten to use these hips yet!”

findings.current: A lot had changed over the past year—not only the Level displayed in my Status Window, but also the number of stats and Titles.
findings.defect: The draft says the number of stats changed, while the source says the numerical values changed, along with the number of Titles.
findings.rationale: 숫자 refers to the displayed numbers themselves; only 칭호 is explicitly counted with 개수.
findings.replacement: A lot had changed over the past year—not only the Level displayed in my Status Window, but also its numbers and the number of Titles.
findings.source: 지난 1년 사이 상태창에 적혀 있는 레벨도, 숫자와 칭호의 개수도 많이 달라졌다.

findings.current:
Even though he was fighting with all his strength, his movements were growing faster.

And stronger.
findings.defect: The draft assigns both clauses to Jongni Chu, changing the omitted subject of “fighting with all his strength” from Taekyung to Jongni Chu.
findings.rationale: The explicit 그의 marks Jongni Chu as the subject of the increasingly fast and powerful movements, while the surrounding first-person narration establishes Taekyung as the one exerting his full strength against him.
findings.replacement:
Even though I was fighting with all my strength, his movements were growing faster.

And stronger.
findings.source: 전력을 다하고 있음에도 그의 움직임은 점점 빨라졌고, 강해졌다.

summary: The draft contains two scene-fact errors, one lost euphemistic joke, one obscured chronological quantity, and two localized wording issues.
